text:
ana: Evening handoff — I need to sign off at 19:30 PT. Sam will be primary, Maria secondary for the next 12h. Leaving a quick credential/access sweep and coverage notes so nothing surprises y'all.

ana: PagerDuty: I switched the rotation to reflect the handoff (see schedule). sam is primary on `#pd-schedule` now. If you lose PD escalations, try the emergency override (ops-leads).

sam: got it. confirm PD id? can you paste the schedule link?

ana: https://pagerduty.com/schedules/REDWOOD_ONCALL_NIGHT_SCHEDULE — primary: sam, secondary: maria.

maria: copy. quick note: we still have that APAC gap between 02:00-04:00 UTC where we only have one oncall in region (no backup). I can try to cover earlier if needed but wanted to flag.

ana: noted — thanks. If an APAC-impacting alert triggers during that window, escalate to the global oncall rota and ping the infra channel.

sam: access checks: I don't have the Grafana "Viewer" for the eu dashboards? I'm seeing 403 on https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/eu/latency-overview

maria: I had the same yesterday — I opened an idempotent request but it didn't flow. Tariq, can you confirm the Grafana role mapping for the oncall group?

tariq: looking. Our mapping is aws:arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/OncallGrafana -> grafana team role viewer. Quick sanity check: are you assuming the oncall-iam role before hitting grafana? Grafana uses SAML + role mapping.

sam: not explicitly. How do I assume?

tariq: run the usual short script:

```bash
# check identity
aws sts get-caller-identity
# assume the oncall role
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/oncall-assume --role-session-name sam-handoff
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=... # creds from assume-role output
```

tariq: then refresh the grafana session (logout/login) or use the internal SSO link: https://sso.redwood.internal/grafana (SSO picks up the role).

sam: thanks. I'll try shortly.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline: canopy-service v2.3.1 -> staging completed at 19:05 PT. No errors reported. :rocket:

incident-bot: Alert P34567: elevated 5xx in ap-east-1 for /v1/generate — current rate 7.2% (threshold 2.0%). Investigating.

ana: re: incident-bot — sam, since that's APAC, if it escalates to SEV we should follow the latency/5xx runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/5xx-apac. Key steps: pin model variant, roll to fallback pool, and notify platform-ops.

sam: okay I'm on the Grafana issue first — if I can't access dashboards, I won't be able to confirm the 5xx spike visually. Maria if you're secondary, please subscribe to the incident channel so you get the PD notifications too.

maria: subscribed. also I tested access to AWS: I can `aws console login` but I can't assume the oncall-assume role (AccessDenied). I filed an internal ticket with IAM and tagged infra on it: https://tickets.redwood/issue/ENG-4821

ana: good call. For immediate needs, use the emergency jumpbox account (ops-jump) which has limited temporary elevation. Steps are in the handoff runbook: https://wiki.redwood/handoffs/credentials-checklist. Remember to record any emergency access in the audit sheet.

sam: workaround working: I assumed the role and Grafana reads fine now. Confirming I can see eu latency dashboards.

maria: reply from IAM: they're applying the fix, ETA ~45m. For APAC window, I can escalate if needed.

ana: two quick operational reminders before I go: 1) If PD escalation fails (no ACK within 2 mins), call the primary's mobile and bleep channel. 2) Always paste the block of logs + time-range when filing an incident. Commands for logs: `kubectl -n canopy logs -l app=canopy --tail=200` and our centralized query: `https://logs.redwood/query?q=service:canopy%20status:5xx`.

sam: noted. one more: where's the emergency AWS assume profile cached? I keep forgetting the profile name.

tariq: profile name is `oncall-emergency`. `aws sso login --profile oncall-emergency` then `aws sts get-caller-identity`.

ana: thanks all. I'm signing off now. If anything lands that needs historical context, check today's timeline in the incident channel. I'll be reachable for 30 mins by phone. :)

ana: handoff complete. :v:
